title: FryWorld plugin manifest (plugin.json)
description: Describes a FryWorld plugin package. Ships at the root of every .fryplugin archive.

id.description: Unique, stable identifier in reverse-domain form. Used as the install folder name, so only letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_' are allowed, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

version.description: Semantic version. The SDK build targets overwrite it with the project's Version property.

entryPoint.description: File name of the assembly holding the plugin, relative to plugin.json. The SDK build targets fill it in when empty.

entryType.description: Full name of the IFryPlugin type in entryPoint. Optional; lets the host skip scanning the assembly.

dependencies.description: Ids of plugins this plugin needs.

isCollectible.description: Whether the plugin can be unloaded without restarting the host. Set false for plugins that cannot unload, such as those hosting Roslyn scripting.

minHostVersion.description: Oldest host version the plugin runs on.

maxHostVersion.description: Newest host version the plugin is known to run on.

sdkVersion.description: FryWorld.Sdk version the plugin was built against. Stamped by the build.

targetFramework.description: Target framework the plugin was built for. Stamped by the build.

settingsSchema.description: User settings, shown as a generated form in the host's plugin manager.
